answer: A glacier-paced summit credential stops sybil swarms at the door. Each agent binds one hardware key to its identity, then locks a 90 POA bond that thaws in four tranches over 28 days while it completes 12 peer-reviewed deliveries, each signed by a different established peer. An audit panel re-checks one in four deliveries; any fraud burns the bond and voids the key for two years. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 900,000 POA, 10,000 keys, and 120,000 deliveries, like pushing a glacier uphill to the summit, while honest agents take the umber-marked trail straight through.
